scope: Preregistered INT8 inference-only development comparison: binary output versus absolute ordered CTC product from the exact same model invocation.
hypothesis: Retaining the learned compact sequence head at inference may reject near words/ordinary speech that the scalar head alone accepts. Test actual open-set development performance; training fit and numerical smoke do not qualify it.
rule: For each unchanged30ms streaming step, read scalar p and all67x6 CTC logits from one shared INT8 invocation. Compute the absolute CTC path-sum probability that the67 states collapse to exactly [hey=1,nyx=2] with blank0, retaining probability mass on other words/blank/repeats. Treatment raw score is p*P_CTC; control raw score is p from this same artifact. Apply the original five-score average and common latch/refractory to each independently. No fitted scale, forced-choice normalization or additional threshold.
validation: Read all and only existing validation feature rows and continuous validation arrays. Source reset/timebase, positive [-.10,+.80]s estimated-end window, negative any-score maxima, duration and event policy match the original evaluator. Retain all per-step clip scores/times and continuous arrays. Correlated variants and weak endpoint estimates remain explicitly limited.
advance: Require both rules to use the same INT8 artifact/invocations, source resets, validation exposure, timebase and event policy. The product must have zero continuous development events and at most1% worst engine and engine/corpus false fraction, plus at least3 macro-recall points over the matched binary comparator. Select comparator at best recall in the same strict gate, otherwise the2% zero-event gate, otherwise minimum-false zero-event point; if no zero-event point exists use its frozen.97 reference and require product worst-group false fraction no greater than that reference. This is development advancement only, not Hi ESP parity or firmware eligibility.
comparator: Apply the existing strict1%/zero-event gate helper to the matched same-artifact binary baseline, with its strict/two-percent/minimum-false-zero-event/frozen.97 fallback policy unchanged. Require at least3 macro-recall points of gain at an eligible product operating point. The old scalar export is context only because this dual model has a new training-only PTQ cache; do not claim its binary outputs replay byte-exact.
stop_policy: Run this one fixed product rule and the fixed21-point grid once. Retain all outcomes. No score-scale/window/threshold sweep outside this plan, further fitting, training on validation failures, final scoring or firmware operation. A failure rejects this inference recipe, not every sequence approach.
limits: Reused development data and previously observed source populations, not independent acceptance. Pointwise score dominance does not imply fewer latched events, so both continuous event counts are measured. Probability is a model path likelihood, not calibrated human wake probability. The full-history output adds compute; P4 RAM/CPU/latency, real-speaker/room recall and long-call stability are unmeasured. No source WAV reading, speaker playback, microphone capture, board access, PCM-speed change or second audio producer.
